name: rug of smothering
desc: Rug of Smothering is a CR 2 construct.

actions.name: damage transfer
actions.desc: While it is &reference[grappling]{Grappling} a creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes the other half.

actions.name: false appearance
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal rug.

actions.name: smother
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is &reference[restrained apply=false], &reference[blinded apply=false], and at risk of &reference[suffocation apply=false]{Suffocating}, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't smother another target. In addition, at the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes [[/damage average]] damage.

actions.name: antimagic susceptibility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is &reference[incapacitated apply=false] while in the area of an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.Eon0jzGzQRNluTPQ]{Antimagic Field}. If targeted by @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.15Fa6q1nH27XfbR8]{Dispel Magic}, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall &reference[unconscious] for 1 minute.
